scope: Bounded data-coverage development experiment; original frozen Motus behavior; W1 BC update, no critic/reward changes
reward_note: Legacy trajectory metadata retained by unchanged collector; successful BC does not use rewards/returns

coverage.selection: First successful episodes by predeclared seed_index; small is exact prefix of large; all192 attempts retained; no extra collection if insufficient
coverage.sampling: Same uniform task/episode/decision rule and draw seed; per-draw FM noise/time identical; audit actual task exposure. Larger trajectory coverage and lower reuse are the intentional treatment.
coverage.fit_noise: Stable episode/decision mapping across both data views; original validation noise indices preserved
coverage.scope_limit: New collection pool and old fixed development validation; no independent final test. Training-size comparison includes different scene/behavior coverage, not a pure diversity mechanism proof.
